/* skeleton */
.skeleton{--bg:rgb(0 0 0 /5%);flex-shrink:0}
.skeleton.p, .skeleton.p i{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
.skeleton.p::before{content:'';padding-block-start:var(--image-ratio);border-radius:var(--layout-corner);background:var(--bg)}
.skeleton.p i::before, .skeleton.p i::after{content:'';display:block;height:6px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--bg)}
.skeleton.p i::after{width:80%}

/* animation */
@keyframes react{to{--err-react:'\0CA0\002C\0CA5'}}
@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(0.9);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--color-tick-90)} 50%{transform:scale(1);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--color-tick-0)} 100%{transform:scale(0.9);box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--color-tick-0)}}

/* ad */
.ad{min-height:60px;border:1px dashed var(--color-tertiary);border-radius:3px} .ad::before{content:attr(data-text)}
.ad-mid{margin-block:1.8rem}
.ad-mob{inset-block-end:0;inset-inline:0;z-index:10} 
.ad-mob .i{min-height:0;border-block-start:1px solid transparent;transition:min-height var(--time), padding var(--time), border var(--time), box-shadow var(--time)} 
.ad-mob .i[open]{min-height:70px;padding-block:5px;border-color:currentColor;box-shadow:0 -15px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 15%)} 
.ad-mob .c{--i:32px;inset-block-start:calc((var(--i) * -1) + 1px);inset-inline-end:0;min-width:calc(var(--i) + 15px);height:var(--i);padding-inline:10px;border:1px solid;border-block-end:0;border-inline-end:0;border-start-start-radius:8px} 
.ad-mob .c span::before{content:var(--open);color:var(--color-secondary);font-size:10px} 
.ad-mob .c:where(.i[open] *) span::before{content:var(--close)}
.ad-mob .c:where(.i:not([open]) *) svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.ad-parallax{height:100dvh;margin-block:1.6em;margin-inline:calc(var(--layout-padding) *-1);clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);transition:height var(--time)} 
.ad-parallax .fill{inset:0;transition:padding .25s ease}
.ad-parallax .fill:where(header:not(.pin) ~main *){padding-block-start:var(--header-height)}
@media (421px >= width){.ad-parallax{display:block}}

.cookie.hide{inset-block-end:-50%;opacity:0}
@media (520px <= width){.cookie{--min:200px;inset-block-end:var(--p);inset-inline-start:var(--p);border-radius:6px}}

  text-align:left!important;

      const reactionCollection = () => collection(db, 'reactions');
      const reactionDoc = (articleKey, uid) => doc(db, 'reactions', String(articleKey) + '__' + String(uid));

      window.PoltekReactionStore = {
        async get(articleKey) {
          const snap = await getDocs(query(reactionCollection(), where('articleKey', '==', String(articleKey))));
          const counts = {};
          snap.docs.forEach(s => {
            const r = s.data()?.reaction;
            if (r) counts[r] = Number(counts[r] || 0) + 1;
          });
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          let mine = null;
          if (user) {
            const vote = snap.docs.find(s => String(s.data()?.uid || '') === String(user.uid));
            if (vote) mine = vote.data()?.reaction || null;
          }
          return { counts, mine };
        },
        async toggle(articleKey, reaction) {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) throw new Error('LOGIN_REQUIRED');
          const ref = reactionDoc(articleKey, user.uid);
          const existing = await this.get(articleKey);
          if (existing.mine === reaction) {
            await deleteDoc(ref);
          } else {
            await setDoc(ref, {
              articleKey: String(articleKey),
              uid: String(user.uid),
              reaction: String(reaction),
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              path: location.pathname
            }, { merge: true });
          }
          return await this.get(articleKey);
        }
      };

      window.PoltekBookmarkStore = {
        async list() {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) return [];
          const snap = await getDocs(bookmarkCollection(user.uid));
          return snap.docs.map(s => ({ id: s.id, ...s.data() }));
        },
        async save(item) {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) throw new Error('LOGIN_REQUIRED');
          const clean = {
            id: String(item.id),
            name: String(item.name || 'Artikel tanpa judul'),
            link: String(item.link || ''),
            img: String(item.img || ''),
            tag: String(item.tag || ''),
            tagurl: String(item.tagurl || ''),
            promo: String(item.promo || ''),
            add: item.add || new Date().toISOString()
          };
          await setDoc(bookmarkDoc(user.uid, clean.id), clean, { merge: true });
          return clean;
        },
        async remove(id) {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) throw new Error('LOGIN_REQUIRED');
          await deleteDoc(bookmarkDoc(user.uid, id));
        },
        async clear() {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) throw new Error('LOGIN_REQUIRED');
          const snap = await getDocs(bookmarkCollection(user.uid));
          if (!snap.empty) {
            const batch = writeBatch(db);
            snap.docs.forEach(s => batch.delete(s.ref));
            await batch.commit();
          }
        },
        async migrateGuest() {
          const user = auth.currentUser;
          if (!user) return;
          let guest = [];
          try { guest = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bookmark') || '[]'); } catch (_) { guest = []; }
          if (!Array.isArray(guest) || !guest.length) return;
          const existing = await this.list();
          const ids = new Set(existing.map(x => String(x.id)));
          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          guest.forEach(item => {
            if (!item || item.id == null || ids.has(String(item.id))) return;
            batch.set(bookmarkDoc(user.uid, item.id), {
              id: String(item.id), name: String(item.name || 'Artikel tanpa judul'),
              link: String(item.link || ''), img: String(item.img || ''),
              tag: String(item.tag || ''), tagurl: String(item.tagurl || ''),
              promo: String(item.promo || ''), add: item.add || new Date().toISOString()
            }, { merge: true });
          });
          await batch.commit();
          localStorage.removeItem('bookmark');
        }
